verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Smithery publishing MCP servers that already exist: by URL for servers deployed elsewhere, as MCPB bundles for stdio servers, or via Uplink for servers running on any machine. Nothing documents generating a hosted MCP server from an OpenAPI definition or from plain custom code without writing the MCP protocol layer. The 'Smithery handles the MCP protocol' claim refers to consuming servers through its REST interface, not to building them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing
